earnings_proxy.formula: E0 = TTM GAAP net income + Q3 one-time noncash tax charge - YTD useful-life net-income benefit
earnings_proxy.label: partial adjusted-earnings proxy, not fully normalized earnings
limitations: The TTM ends 2025-09-30 and is not FY2025 actual earnings.
2,572 million is Q3 diluted weighted-average shares, explicitly stale; neither a December share count nor a reported TTM denominator.
Only the two mandated adjustments are made; other nonrecurring items, sustainable tax rate, future depreciation and investment returns remain unresolved.
The tax charge is not added to CFO.
SBC remains included in earnings costs; no automatic second deduction. Zero net share change is an assumption, not free buybacks.

additional_material_parameter_revision.reason: E1 scopes some core-ad efficacy improvements; E2 and E3 contain uncalibrated judgments/anchors. None supplies incremental economic profit, attributable total-spend ROI or a defensible five-year earnings/multiple calibration.

unsupported_branches: No present intrinsic value, actionable target price, scenario probabilities, FCFF model or maintenance capex estimate.

No dividend-inclusive total return; zero dividend credit does not assert that dividends do not exist.
